summary: yoloAI (github.com/kstenerud/yoloai) is a Go CLI (`cmd/yoloai`, cobra) that is itself a sandbox runner for other coding agents: it builds its own `yoloai-base` Docker image (Debian trixie + Node 22 + Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Aider, OpenCode) and runs the chosen agent inside a disposable container/VM via a backend (docker/podman/containerd on Linux; seatbelt/tart/apple on macOS). It never calls a model API itself; the model calls are made by the agent it launches. `yoloai run <name> <workdir> --prompt "..." --wait` runs the agent headlessly (for Claude: `claude -p "PROMPT" --dangerously-skip-permissions`) and exits when the agent exits. Credentials are read from the host env (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude) and delivered into the sandbox; by default on Linux/docker the key is "brokered" through a host-side injector that hard-codes https://api.anthropic.com, so `--no-broker` plus `--env ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_URL` is required to route Claude Code at the recording proxy (Anthropic messages API). The workdir is given as `.:rw` (live bind mount) so edits land in the task directory without a separate `yoloai apply` step. The docker backend shells out to `docker build --provenance=false --sbom=false -` (needs the docker CLI + buildx) and needs a reachable daemon, so the run command starts a nested dockerd when none is provided (container must run `--privileged`, or DOCKER_HOST must point at a daemon that shares this filesystem).
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=debian:bookworm-slim
FROM ${BASE}

# yoloAI is a Go CLI that launches coding agents (Claude Code by default) inside
# a container it builds itself. Its docker backend needs the `docker` CLI plus
# buildx (it runs `docker build --provenance=false --sbom=false -`), and a
# reachable daemon at run time (dockerd is started by the run command when no
# DOCKER_HOST / socket is provided). Everything harness-specific lives under
# /opt/harness; the base image's own toolchains are untouched.
ARG GO_VERSION=1.26.5
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl gnupg git tmux iptables procps \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Docker CE (daemon + CLI + buildx) from Docker's apt repo; works on Debian and Ubuntu bases.
RUN install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings \
 && . /etc/os-release \
 && curl -fsSL "https://download.docker.com/linux/${ID}/gpg" -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc \
 && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc \
 && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/${ID} ${VERSION_CODENAME} stable" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list \
 && apt-get update \
 && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin fuse-overlayfs \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# Nested dockerd cannot stack overlayfs on the container's own overlay root; a
# volume here gives it a real backing filesystem when the runtime honours VOLUME.
VOLUME /var/lib/docker

# Self-contained Go toolchain under /opt/harness (never the base image's).
RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin \
 && ARCH="$(dpkg --print-architecture)" \
 && curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz" | tar -C /opt/harness -xz

# Build the harness's own CLI from the repo source (build context = repo root).
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN cd /opt/harness/src \
 && VERSION="$(git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo dev)" \
 && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOTOOLCHAIN=auto GOPATH=/opt/harness/gopath GOMODCACHE=/opt/harness/gopath/pkg/mod GOCACHE=/opt/harness/gocache GOFLAGS=-mod=mod \
    /opt/harness/go/bin/go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${VERSION}" -o /opt/harness/bin/yoloai ./cmd/yoloai \
 && rm -rf /opt/harness/gocache

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:/opt/harness/go/bin:$PATH
run_command:
set -u
export HOME="${HOME:-/root}"
DATA_DIR="${YOLOAI_DATA_DIR:-/out/yoloai}"
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR" /out/logs

# yoloai's docker backend needs a daemon. Use DOCKER_HOST / an existing socket if
# given; otherwise start dockerd in this container (requires --privileged). The
# bridge subnet is moved off 172.17/16 so a proxy on the outer docker bridge stays routable.
start_dockerd() {
  dockerd --bip=10.213.0.1/24 --default-address-pool base=10.214.0.0/16,size=24 "$@" >>/out/logs/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
  local pid=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
    docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
    kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 1
  done
  kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2
  return 1
}
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" ]; then
  mkdir -p /var/lib/docker
  # overlayfs cannot nest on an overlay root (happens when the VOLUME is not
  # honoured): fall back to the vfs graphdriver, which works anywhere (slower, more disk).
  if [ "$(stat -f -c %T /var/lib/docker 2>/dev/null)" = "overlayfs" ]; then
    start_dockerd --storage-driver=vfs --feature containerd-snapshotter=false
  else
    start_dockerd || start_dockerd --storage-driver=vfs --feature containerd-snapshotter=false
  fi
fi
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "yoloai: no docker daemon reachable (run the container with --privileged, or set DOCKER_HOST)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

NAME="task-$(date +%s)"
yoloai --data-dir "$DATA_DIR" run "$NAME" ".:rw" \
  --agent claude --model "${YOLOAI_MODEL:-sonnet}" \
  --no-broker --allow-dirty \
  --env "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=${ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL}" \
  --env "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:-proxy}" \
  --wait --prompt "$TASK" 2>&1 | tee /out/logs/yoloai-run.log
rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

# Preserve the sandbox's trajectory (agent.log = raw agent output, *.jsonl = structured logs).
cp -r "$DATA_DIR/sandboxes/$NAME/logs" /out/sandbox-logs 2>/dev/null || true
yoloai --data-dir "$DATA_DIR" destroy "$NAME" --abandon-unapplied >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
exit "$rc"
check_command: yoloai --help >/dev/null && yoloai version && yoloai run --help >/dev/null && docker buildx version >/dev/null
notes:
What yoloAI is: a meta-harness. It does not contain a model client; it runs a vendor agent CLI (Claude Code by default) inside a sandbox it builds. Packaging it therefore means Docker-in-Docker, and the recipe has hard requirements the ordinary harness contract does not anticipate:

1. Needs a Docker daemon. The docker backend requires the `docker` CLI + buildx and a reachable daemon. The run command starts `dockerd` inside the task container when none is reachable, which requires the container to run with `--privileged`. Alternatively set DOCKER_HOST to an outside daemon, but then yoloai's bind mounts (sandbox dir under /out/yoloai, the task workdir) must resolve to the same paths on the daemon host, which is normally not true.
2. Needs internet at first run. On first `yoloai run` it builds the multi-GB `yoloai-base` image (apt from deb.debian.org, docker.com, NodeSource; `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` etc.). With an ephemeral nested dockerd this happens on every run (several minutes). The "no network beyond the proxy" requirement cannot be met by this harness; the model traffic itself does go only to the proxy.
3. Proxy reachability: the agent runs in a nested container, so $PROXY_URL must be routable from inside it (not localhost of the outer host). The nested bridge is set to 10.213.0.1/24 (pools 10.214/16) to avoid clashing with an outer 172.17.0.1 proxy address. If PROXY_URL is a localhost address it will not work; yoloai's own localhost check only inspects AuthHint vars, so it won't warn.
4. Routing: `--no-broker` is mandatory. The default Linux/docker credential broker rewrites ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL to its own injector, which forwards to https://api.anthropic.com. With --no-broker, `--env ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=$PROXY_URL` and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=proxy are delivered to Claude Code in the sandbox (host env ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is also picked up automatically and is needed so headless mode is not downgraded to interactive, D101). Claude Code sends an Anthropic messages request with model "sonnet" (yoloai passes aliases through) to $PROXY_URL/v1/messages.
5. Workdir: passed as `.:rw` (live bind mount) so edits happen directly in the task dir; no `yoloai apply` needed and non-git dirs are fine. Nested dockerd shares this container's mount namespace so the bind mount resolves. Sandbox logs (logs/agent.log raw agent output, cli.jsonl, sandbox.jsonl, monitor.jsonl, agent-hooks.jsonl) are copied to /out/sandbox-logs; yoloai's data dir is /out/yoloai; dockerd log at /out/logs/dockerd.log.
6. Nested storage: overlayfs can't stack on an overlay root. `VOLUME /var/lib/docker` makes runtimes that honour VOLUME give a real fs (verified: native overlay2 + containerd snapshotter then works); otherwise the script falls back to `--storage-driver=vfs --feature containerd-snapshotter=false` (verified working; fuse-overlayfs was tried and its builds failed, so it is not used).

Verification done locally (Docker 29, arm64): overlay builds on buildpack-deps:jammy; check_command passes (yoloai --help/version, `yoloai system backends` probes cleanly, buildx present); privileged run starts nested dockerd and yoloai's base-image build proceeds through its Dockerfile (still building when this recipe was finalised, so the full Claude-Code-through-proxy round trip was NOT observed end to end). A fake Anthropic SSE endpoint test script exists but its result was not captured before finalising.

Other agents: swap `--agent claude` for gemini/codex/aider/opencode; the broker/base-URL wiring differs per agent (Codex reads base URL from config.toml, Gemini uses GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL), so only Claude is wired here. YOLOAI_MODEL selects the model name passed via `--model`.
